title: vibe-loop-git v0.2 — Latency Budget
rationale: Latency is the difference between a vibe-loop-git the operator uses and one they abandon. We anchor on Jakob Nielsen's 0.1s/1s/10s thresholds (1993, validated Miller 1968 + Card 1991) and synthesize 2026 SOTA benchmarks (kunalganglani via Artificial Analysis) with our own Phase 14 stress data (row 2472). All numbers are tier-1 source-backed.

nielsen_0_1s.user_experience: model of the user's thought (instant feel)

nielsen_1s.user_experience: flow of thought uninterrupted (user notices but stays engaged)

nielsen_10s.user_experience: user attention budget; beyond this, abandonment risk
nielsen_10s.applies_to: single vibe_publish + C7 bundle (batch mode multi-step)

ultra_cheap.rationale: small models, smallest context, fastest TTFT (Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite leads at 0.35s)

cheap.rationale: default tier; matches our Phase 14 stress measurements on chat-minimax-cn
cheap.tier_1_evidence: Phase 14 stress (row 2472) — chat-minimax-cn p50=2576ms sequential, 5-7% variance

medium.rationale: MoE sweet spot (Llama 4 Scout, DeepSeek V3) — large quality, mid latency
medium.tier_1_evidence: kunalganglani — Llama 4 Scout 107.3 t/s MoE 109B/17B active $0.66; DeepSeek V3 $0.89 MoE 671B/37B

frontier.rationale: frontier models pay 3-10x for marginal quality; budget matches worst-case UX
frontier.tier_1_evidence: kunalganglani — GPT-4o 171.8 t/s $10/1M; benchlm — Fable 5 $10/$50 per 1M

openai.warning: gpt-4o-mini is the slowest budget model in 2026 (53.6 tok/s — #50/84). Prefer gpt-4.1-mini or DeepSeek V3 instead.

minimax.tier_1_evidence: Phase 14 stress row 2472 — p50=2576ms sequential, p99=18522ms on chat-minimax-cn (api.minimaxi.com)

google.tier_1_evidence: kunalganglani — Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite 0.35s TTFT, 213.5 tok/s, $0.10/1M input — best latency/price 2026

single_vibe_publish.tier_1_evidence: Phase 14 stress row 2472 — single drift_judge p50=2576ms

c7_bundle.description: 1 orchestrator + N subtasks (parallel max_concurrent=4) + 1 coherence check
c7_bundle.tier_1_evidence: kunalganglani — '5-step agentic pipeline 800ms each = 4s before user sees anything'; Loop 3 cost_latency_controls; per Anthropic Cookbook parallel dispatch

vibe_loop_git_itself.rationale: mod has NO startup cost (per Loop 4 coldstart-rules.md §1) — files read at vibe_publish time

llm_provider_jit_warmup.rationale: first call after binding pays JIT warm-up; subsequent calls benefit from prompt cache

llm_provider_model_load.rationale: if provider scales to zero (serverless GPU), boot takes 6 CPU-bound phases per vLLM MLSys paper (60s+). NOT our concern for chat APIs but documents why we don't recommend self-hosted.
llm_provider_model_load.rationale_for_not_recommending: scale-to-zero economics break under $10k/month per groundy.com Jun 2026

variance_budget.rationale: legitimate model variance on borderline specs — NOT drift, NOT error
variance_budget.abort_threshold: consecutive 3 needs_human verdicts → abort vibe_publish + surface to operator

force_concurrency.rationale: operator may force higher concurrency for fast providers, lower for rate-limited

max_total_latency_seconds.rationale: killswitch — abort vibe_publish if exceeded. Default null = no limit (cascade_budgets.ceiling_ms used instead).

skip_orchestrator.rationale: true = use c7-subrouter.json static_predefined strategy; saves 1 orchestrator LLM call (~5s)

retry_on_variance.rationale: false = do not auto-retry needs_human; operator handles manually

force_tier.rationale: override Loop 2 tier_selection_rules; recommended for known-sensitive contexts

evidence.claim: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite TTFT 0.35s, 213.5 tok/s, $0.40/1M output. Mercury 2 841 tok/s. GPT-4o mini 53.6 tok/s — slowest budget. 0.1/1/10s Nielsen thresholds. Anthropic prompt cache 0.1x.
vLLM cold boot = 6 CPU-bound phases, default -O2 mode ~52s torch.compile alone, scale-to-zero economics break under $10k/month.
Breaking the Ice: Analyzing Cold Start Latency in vLLM. Jun 5, 2026. First systematic breakdown of vLLM startup latency. Predictive model for autoscaler planning.
Claude API pricing Oct 2026. Haiku 4.5 $1/1M input. Fable 5 $10/$50 per 1M. Prompt caching 60-90% discounts.

100 sequential p50=2576ms p95=4742ms p99=18522ms; 100 concurrent-5-workers p50=2879ms p95=9840ms p99=15504ms. 5-7% needs_human from variance. 3.7x wall-time speedup concurrent vs sequential. MiniMax queues concurrent not parallelism.
Per-tier cost: ultra_cheap $0.05-0.15, cheap $0.15-0.60, medium $0.60-3.00, frontier $3.00-15.00 per 1M tokens.
5 providers × 4 tiers, auto-mirror strategy. tier_selection_rules + voting defaults.
max_subtasks=8, max_concurrent_subtasks=4, timeouts (orchestrator=30s, subtask=60s, coherence=15s). cascade math derived from these caps.
Jakob Nielsen, 1993. Response time thresholds: 0.1s (instant), 1s (flow), 10s (attention limit). Validated Miller 1968, Card et al. 1991. Cited in kunalganglani 2026.
